view: WITH x AS (SELECT o.cid AS cid, o.id AS oid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.cid = c.cid GROUP BY o.cid, o.id) SELECT x.cid AS cid, SUM(x.n) AS total FROM x GROUP BY x.cid
metric: WITH x AS (SELECT o.cid AS cid, o.id AS oid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.cid = c.cid GROUP BY o.cid, o.id) SELECT MAX(x.n) AS peak FROM x
